one_liner: Google AI notebook; programmatic access only via Gemini Notebook Enterprise preview APIs.
auth_notes: Google Cloud OAuth2 access tokens (gcloud auth print-access-token); caller needs Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role.
credential_path: Google Cloud project plus Gemini Notebook Enterprise license; assign Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role.
breadth_note: Enterprise-only notebook CRUD, sources, sharing, audio overviews; no consumer NotebookLM endpoints.

mcp.note: No official NotebookLM/Gemini Notebook MCP server found in Google documentation reviewed.

blocker: No consumer API; enterprise preview APIs need GCP project plus Gemini Enterprise license.
notes: Consumer NotebookLM has no public API. Enterprise APIs are pre-GA preview. Third-party 'NotebookLM APIs' are separate reverse-engineered services.

one_liner: Meeting transcription; OAuth MCP for normal accounts, REST API Enterprise-only.
auth_notes: MCP uses OAuth 2.1 browser consent; Public API uses static Bearer API keys, capped at two per user.
credential_path: MCP: OAuth sign-in with a standard Otter account. REST keys: Enterprise workspace settings only.
breadth_note: Channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, workspace and super-admin endpoints.

mcp.note: Official remote MCP documented in Otter help center; OAuth-only, read-only tools (search meetings, fetch transcript, user info). Rejects API keys.

blocker: REST Public API gated to Enterprise workspaces; MCP alternative is read-only and OAuth-only.
notes: help.otter.ai blocked WebFetch with 403; details come from search snippets and third-party analysis. Webhook support not directly verified.

one_liner: AI meeting recorder with public REST API, OAuth, webhooks and MCP.
auth_notes: Self-serve API key from User Settings API Access; OAuth 2.0 authorization code for distributed third-party apps.
credential_path: Generate key at fathom.video/customize#api-access-header; register an OAuth app for multi-tenant integrations.
breadth_note: Meetings, meeting types, recordings, summaries, transcripts, downloads, teams, members, users, webhooks.

mcp.note: Official MCP docs with ChatGPT and Claude setup pages; exact remote server endpoint not captured in retrieved pages.

rate_limits: 60 req/min standard; 30/min for transcripts, summaries, downloads
notes: FAQ states API keys and webhooks are included on all plans. Keys are user-scoped to own or shared meetings. Base: api.fathom.ai/external/v1.

one_liner: AI search over 220M research papers via self-serve REST API and MCP.
auth_notes: x-api-key header; keys self-issued from the API & MCP dashboard inside a Consensus account. No OAuth documented.
credential_path: Create key in Consensus account API & MCP dashboard; plan credits then $0.05 per call.
breadth_note: Essentially one search endpoint over 220M papers with rich filters; read-only, no writes.

mcp.note: Consensus markets an official MCP for Claude/ChatGPT/Copilot sharing the account and credits; remote server endpoint URL not confirmed.

notes: Hint says 'OAuth requested' but documented auth is x-api-key only. docs.consensus.app returned 403; endpoint details from search snippets.

one_liner: Document parsing and extraction API with self-serve keys, SDKs and MCP.
auth_notes: Bearer API key created in the Reducto studio/platform dashboard; SDKs read the REDUCTO_API_KEY environment variable.
credential_path: Sign up at studio.reducto.ai, create key under API Keys; free starter credits then usage billing.
breadth_note: Parse, extract, split, edit, upload plus async jobs; public OpenAPI 3.1 spec published.

mcp.note: Quickstart documents a Reducto MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and other coding agents; separate MCP endpoint URL not captured.

notes: Pricing roughly $10/1k pages parse and $20/1k extract, 20% async discount, ~15k free credits. Rate limits not published.

one_liner: Autonomous coding agent with broad REST API and official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer service-user or personal API keys (cog_ prefix); legacy apk_ keys rejected by MCP. Enterprise adds X-Org-Id header.
credential_path: Generate a service user or personal API key in Devin account settings; requires an active Devin account.
breadth_note: Sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, schedules, attachments, repo wikis, enterprise analytics and user management.

mcp.note: Official Streamable-HTTP MCP with API-key auth; covers sessions, playbooks, knowledge, schedules, integrations and public/private repo wikis.

notes: v3 API at api.devin.ai/v3 with organization and enterprise scopes; v1/v2 still work. Webhook support and rate limits unconfirmed.

one_liner: Generative image and video suite with documented REST API, CLI and skills.
auth_notes: Header 'Authorization: Key <key_id>:<key_secret>' from cloud.higgsfield.ai; the CLI instead uses account login, no key.
credential_path: Create API key id/secret at cloud.higgsfield.ai; CLI path uses 'higgsfield auth login' and plan credits.
breadth_note: Async generative media endpoints: text/image-to-video, soul images, product photoshoot; poll or webhook for results.

mcp.note: Help center describes both an MCP for chat agents and CLI+skills for coding agents; MCP server endpoint URL not retrieved.

notes: API docs confirm key/secret auth, base api.higgsfield.ai, async jobs, 7-day output retention. Full model endpoint list and rate limits not retrieved.

one_liner: Open-source npm CLI rendering Mermaid diagrams to SVG, PNG or PDF.
auth_notes: No authentication at all; runs locally via npm, npx, Docker or Podman. No hosted service exists.
credential_path: None. npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, or use minlag/mermaid-cli Docker image.
breadth_note: Single mmdc command: diagram or markdown in, SVG/PNG/PDF out, with themes and transparent backgrounds.

mcp.note: No MCP server in the official repo. Third-party Mermaid MCP servers exist but were not verified in this pass.

notes: Correct finding: no auth, no hosted API. A toolkit wraps a local binary or container, not a remote service. Homebrew install discontinued.

one_liner: Third-party YouTube transcript, search and channel API with credit pricing.
auth_notes: Authorization: Bearer <api_key> from the account dashboard; 100 free credits granted on signup.
credential_path: Sign up at transcriptapi.com, copy key from dashboard; 100 free credits, then $5/month for 5,000.
breadth_note: Seven read-only endpoints: transcript, info, search, channel resolve, channel videos, playlist videos.

mcp.note: Vendor markets a YouTube MCP for ChatGPT and Claude sharing the same credit pool; MCP endpoint URL not captured.

notes: Small independent vendor, not Google. Base transcriptapi.com/api/v2. Depends on YouTube captions, so ToS and durability risk for production agents.

one_liner: Meeting recorder with full REST API, OAuth2, access tokens and webhooks.
auth_notes: Bearer personal or workspace access token, or OAuth2 authorization code with PKCE; Public-Api-Version header required.
credential_path: Personal tokens on Starter and above; workspace tokens need Business/Enterprise admin. Free plan has no API.
breadth_note: Recordings CRUD and upload, transcripts (json/txt/vtt/srt), AI notes, tags, sharing, users, teams, webhooks.

mcp.note: No official Grain MCP server found in developers.grain.com or the support article reviewed.

notes: Base api.grain.com. Webhook events include recording.added, highlight.added, recording.removed. Workspace tokens expose all workspace data.
